reviews.x: This waterpik is not from the Waterpik company, it was a repackaged Costco model. I know because the large unit didn't work (motor would not turn on) so I called Waterpik and they told me that model number was only sold at Costco, not from them directly or from Amazon's fulfillment center. Buyer Beware!

reviews.t: Box came with seal broken and brush set package was open
reviews.x: When I received this package the box that came was not an Amazon box that I’m used to receiving. It came in the original box the manufacturer had then the seal of the box looked to have been open but carefully put back. When I opened up the box it came with 2 packages of brushes, one for the main machine and the other for the travel size, both brush packaging was open. I returned the item and asked for another one.

I’m so sad...I love the waterpick brand but this particular water flosser stop working 8 days after the last day of return. It last it a month! Really? Who I’m suppose to contact now to get a exchange or a refund?

reviews.t: Make sure you try it out and it works before you throw away box
reviews.x: I would have liked it if it worked. I have purchased this before and had no problems so upon receiving, I just assumed it would work . WRONG. I threw out packaging before trying it out and guess what-motor will not pump water. Nano works fine so I guess I spent $85.00 on a Nano.

This is my second unit I purchased for the kids.  I wanted to try it on trial basis and see if my oral hygiene would improve and it has. My dental hygienist highly recommend a oral spray so I chose this unit.  With regular flossing, waterpik and final step brushing in this order, I have noticed an overall improvement, gums no longer bleed and a reduction of morning and bad breath.  In the reservoir I added about 2oz of Hydrogen peroxide, a cap full of crest gum care mouthwash and spray away.  My

reviews.t: Good substitute for flossing and easier to do
reviews.x: Prescribed by our dentist and seems to be as effective as flossing.  Water pressure is adjustable.  We took the 'travel unit' with us to use on overnight trips.

reviews.t: Seller is selling old merchandise. It may be unopened, but it is a year and half old
reviews.x: I didn't like that I was led to believe I was buying a new product only to find out when I tried to get a leaking hose replaced, the Manufacturer told me the unit was a 1 1/2 years old and previously sold by Costco and Sams' Club as a special product. The Manufacture does not cover the warranty on old merchandise. The package was shipped in the original package and it was crushed in several places. USPS is not very gentle.

This is going to be a Birthday gift in October and I received it with the seal broke and box torn. I looked at everything inside and it looks new and all is there. Just wasn't happy that the box was damaged so I'm still going to give it as a gift. I have a waterpik myself and I love it!
WORKS WELL.  THE TANK GOES THROUGH WATER REALLY QUICKLY, SO I WISH THE TANK WAS LARGER.

No I did not buy this through Amazon but I have rarely disliked a product more so I feel moved to have my say about it.  I have used the old standard water pik for years.  This model is by no means anything like the old standby.  For one it is noisy and sounds cheap like it may give up sooner rather than later. Love that it comes with the travel one and a second set of attachments.

reviews.t: Easy to share and easy for kids to use
reviews.x: I purchased this product after reading the reviews. I kept going back and forth between this combo or the one with the handheld travel option. I’m happy I chose this combo. The main purpose was for my son who has braces since regular flossing has been a challenge. I was a bit wary about sharing the unit so I thought he could use one and I the other, but after testing them out I can see why sharing one unit is not a problem. Now we will have the nano for travel. So far the results have been great

The unit was great.  Then it stopped working.  I called WaterPik.  They said Green Dot was an unauthorized dealer.  They are standing behind their product and sending me a new one.  DO NOT PURCHASE from this vendor.

reviews.t: Beware nano will not fully shut off the water runs thru tip until all water empties out
reviews.x: Both clean great, but problem is with the nano when I shut it off it still spouts out water from the tip until all the water empties out.  Something wrong with it. Returned.

reviews.t: No longer works after three months :(
reviews.x: I was very excited to get this great deal on a Waterpik Flosser and a bonus travel Waterpik.  Unfortunately after only three months and occasional usage, my husband went to use it this past weekend and it was completely dead.  Tried to troubleshoot with no luck and spoke with a representative from Amazon who said unfortunately the 30-day window for "returns/replacements" had passed and there wasn't anything he could do for me.  Very disappointed in the service -- one would hope that you would be
Bought it in February and now it leaks in June. I’m beyond my return window so I’m stuck with garbage. Don’t risk it. Stay away from this product.
First one broke the very next morning. Replacement got here fast, it still works but my faith in the product is lacking.
Arrived with seal broken. Did not look new. May have been repackaged.
Hubby likes it. The loud motor noise bothers me.

reviews.t: Great value. You won’t regret the purchase.
reviews.x: Two water picks in this box.  The one for the house is smaller than some so takes less space on your vanity. Is still just as powerful as others on the market. The travel one has its own zip up case and fits in the bottom of my back pack....it has everything, and works just the same, as my home one. I’ve used water picks since the late 60’s. He can sleep through a lot, but not a lawnmower running in the same room. claims.text: Several reviewers received units that did not work, with motors failing to pump water or turn on.
Multiple reviewers reported the box seal was broken or the packaging appeared opened or damaged.
Some reviewers noted the product was an older or repackaged Costco/Sam's Club model not covered by the manufacturer's warranty.
Many reviewers were satisfied, citing improved gum health and effectiveness as a flossing substitute.
Reviewers appreciated the included travel unit and extra attachments as a good value.
